query:
SELECT g.game_id, g.game_state
           FROM games g
           WHERE g.game_date < CURRENT_DATE
             AND ($1::date IS NULL OR g.game_date >= $1)
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.game_id = g.game_id
             )
           ORDER BY g.game_date ASC, g.game_id ASC
